buildCommand: rm -rf site-dist && mkdir site-dist && sh -n install.sh && cp site/index.html install.sh docs/img/tui-demo.svg docs/img/tui-grid.svg site-dist/
ignoreCommand: [ "$VERCEL_ENV" != production ] || git diff --quiet HEAD^ HEAD -- site install.sh docs/img vercel.json .vercelignore || exit 1
